The AMI Chiropractic Clinic is a family friendly chiropractic practice near Kempston, Bedford that will take care of all of your healthcare needs. We offer a unique and a holistic approach to help treat and manage a number of conditions. 

Our treatments include chiropractic, muscle and exercise techniques, postural correction, lifestyle modification, nutritional advice, deep tissue massage, sports massage, reflexology, medical acupuncture and dry needling.

Our experienced and fully qualified chiropractors will listen to all your concerns, identify the cause of your pain and symptoms, and recommend a course of action to get you moving and feeling better as quickly as possible.

Our aim at the AMI Chiropractic Clinic is help you achieve your goals; whether that is pain relief, injury management, postural correction, stress reduction, sport performance or overall health and wellness.

It is our mission to enhance, educate and empower our local community in Kempston, Bedford.
